```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(plotly); library(reactable); library(htmltools)
})

repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("run_pipeline.R"))
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

invisible(lapply(sort(list.files(file.path(repo_root, "R"),
                                 pattern = "^\\d+_.*\\.R$",
                                 full.names = TRUE)), source))
cfg_path <- params$config
if (!file.exists(cfg_path)) cfg_path <- file.path(repo_root, cfg_path)
cfg <- load_config(cfg_path)

rcfg <- modifyList(
  list(
    top_n_taxa              = 25,
    top_n_genes             = 30,
    rank_taxa_by            = "prevalence_x_abundance",
    other_bucket            = TRUE,
    daa_extra               = "significant",
    network_top_nodes       = 50,
    network_edge_min_weight = 0.3,
    show_per_group_chord    = TRUE,
    show_per_group_sankey   = TRUE,
    embed_sankey_widgets    = TRUE
  ),
  cfg$report %||% list()
)

ds_root  <- file.path(cfg$project_root, cfg$outputs$datasets_dir)
fig_root <- file.path(cfg$project_root, cfg$outputs$figures_dir)
group    <- cfg$metadata$group_cols[[1]]
sid      <- cfg$metadata$sample_id_col

# ---- small utilities --------------------------------------------------------

read_csv_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readr::read_csv(p, show_col_types = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
read_tsv_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(p, show_col_types = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
read_text_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  paste(readLines(p, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}
empty_card <- function(msg) htmltools::div(
  style = "padding:1rem;color:#666;font-style:italic;", msg
)
rt <- function(df, ...) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(empty_card("No data."))
  reactable::reactable(
    df, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
    pagination = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 12,
    bordered = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
    ...
  )
}

# Generic top-N selector — returns the top features by the configured ranking
# applied to a (sample, feature, value) long tibble.
top_features <- function(long, n, by = rcfg$rank_taxa_by,
                          feature_col = "feature", value_col = "value") {
  if (is.null(long) || !nrow(long)) return(character())
  s <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[feature_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_abundance = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abundance  = max(.data[[value_col]],  na.rm = TRUE),
      prevalence     = mean(.data[[value_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(prevalence_x_abundance = prevalence * mean_abundance)
  s <- s[order(-s[[by]]), ]
  head(s[[feature_col]], n)
}

apply_top_n <- function(long, n, feature_col = "feature",
                         value_col = "value", with_other = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(long) || !nrow(long)) return(long)
  keep <- top_features(long, n, feature_col = feature_col, value_col = value_col)
  if (!with_other) return(dplyr::filter(long, .data[[feature_col]] %in% keep))
  long[[feature_col]] <- ifelse(long[[feature_col]] %in% keep,
                                long[[feature_col]], "Others")
  grp_cols <- setdiff(colnames(long), value_col)
  long |>
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(grp_cols))) |>
    dplyr::summarise(!!value_col := sum(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop")
}

# ---- load artifacts ---------------------------------------------------------

art <- list(
  composition = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "relative_abundance",
                                        "composition_long.csv")),
  alpha       = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "alpha_diversity.csv")),
  beta        = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "beta_diversity_pcoa.csv")),
  permanova   = read_text_safe(file.path(fig_root, "beta_diversity", "permanova.txt")),
  permdisp    = read_text_safe(file.path(fig_root, "beta_diversity", "permdisp.txt")),

  daa_taxa = list(
    merged     = read_tsv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "taxa",
                                          "merged_pairwise_with_overall.tsv")),
    pair_files = list.files(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "taxa"),
                            pattern = "^[^.]+_vs_[^.]+\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE),
    candidates = list.files(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "taxa"),
                            pattern = "^candidates_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  ),
  daa_gene = list(
    merged     = read_tsv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "gene",
                                          "merged_pairwise_with_overall.tsv")),
    pair_files = list.files(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "gene"),
                            pattern = "^[^.]+_vs_[^.]+\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE),
    candidates = list.files(file.path(ds_root, "aldex2", "gene"),
                            pattern = "^candidates_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  ),

  resistome = list(
    alpha = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "resistome", "alpha_diversity.csv")),
    drug  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "resistome", "drug_total_TPM.csv")),
    pcoa  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "resistome", "beta_pcoa_scores.csv"))
  ),
  virulome = list(
    alpha = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "virulome", "alpha_diversity.csv")),
    drug  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "virulome", "vf_total_TPM.csv")),
    pcoa  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "virulome", "beta_pcoa_scores.csv"))
  ),
  mobilome = list(
    alpha = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "mobilome", "alpha_diversity.csv")),
    drug  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "mobilome", "mge_total_TPM.csv")),
    pcoa  = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "mobilome", "beta_pcoa_scores.csv"))
  ),

  network = list(
    nodes    = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "network", "gephi_nodes.csv")),
    edges    = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "network", "gephi_edges.csv")),
    topology = read_csv_safe(file.path(ds_root, "network", "topology.csv")),
    chord_overall = file.path(fig_root, "network", "chord_overall.png"),
    # list.files() uses POSIX ERE (no lookaround, no `perl =` arg) — list
    # every chord_*.png then drop the overall one in R.
    chord_groups  = {
      f <- list.files(file.path(fig_root, "network"),
                      pattern = "^chord_.+\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
      f[basename(f) != "chord_overall.png"]
    },
    sankey_overall = file.path(fig_root, "network", "sankey_overall.html"),
    sankey_groups  = {
      f <- list.files(file.path(fig_root, "network"),
                      pattern = "^sankey_.+\\.html$", full.names = TRUE)
      f[basename(f) != "sankey_overall.html"]
    }
  ),

  log = read_text_safe(file.path(cfg$project_root, cfg$outputs$log_file))
)

n_samples <- if (!is.null(art$composition))
  dplyr::n_distinct(art$composition$sample) else NA_integer_
n_taxa <- if (!is.null(art$composition))
  dplyr::n_distinct(art$composition$name) else NA_integer_
n_genes_daa <- if (!is.null(art$daa_gene$merged))
  nrow(art$daa_gene$merged) else NA_integer_
```

# Differential abundance

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| output: asis

render_daa_level <- function(level_label, bundle) {
  if (is.null(bundle$pair_files) || !length(bundle$pair_files)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\nNo ALDEx2 outputs found for %s.\n",
                level_label, level_label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", level_label))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (pf in bundle$pair_files) {
    cn <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pf))
    df <- read_tsv_safe(pf)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) next
    feat_col <- intersect(c("taxon", "GENE"), colnames(df))[1] %||% colnames(df)[1]
    qcol <- intersect(c("wi.eBH", "we.eBH"), colnames(df))[1]
    cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", cn))
    cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

    # Volcano
    cat("\n##### Volcano\n\n")
    if (!is.na(qcol) && "effect" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$neglogq <- -log10(pmax(df[[qcol]], 1e-300))
      df$sig     <- df[[qcol]] < (cfg$stats$alpha %||% 0.05)
      p <- plot_ly(df, x = ~effect, y = ~neglogq, color = ~sig,
                   text = df[[feat_col]], type = "scatter", mode = "markers") |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = "ALDEx2 effect (CLR diff)"),
               yaxis = list(title = sprintf("-log10(%s)", qcol)))
      print(htmltools::tagList(p))
    } else {
      cat("Volcano unavailable — missing effect / eBH columns.\n")
    }

    # Candidates table (already top-N from the stage)
    cat("\n\n##### Candidates\n\n")
    cf <- file.path(dirname(pf), paste0("candidates_", cn, ".csv"))
    cdf <- read_csv_safe(cf)
    if (!is.null(cdf)) print(htmltools::tagList(rt(cdf)))
    else cat("No candidates CSV for this comparison.\n")

    cat("\n\n##### Full table\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(rt(df)))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}

render_daa_level("Taxa", art$daa_taxa)
render_daa_level("Genes", art$daa_gene)
```

# Resistome / Virulome / Mobilome

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| output: asis

# intersect(...)[1] returns NA (not NULL) when nothing matches, so the
# `%||%` fallback alone doesn't save us. first_match returns the first
# real hit, or `fallback` if none — and treats `fallback = NA` as "skip".
first_match <- function(candidates, available, fallback = NA_character_) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, available)
  if (length(hit)) hit[[1]] else fallback
}

render_ge_panel <- function(label, bundle) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", label))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

  cat("\n#### PCoA\n\n")
  if (!is.null(bundle$pcoa)) {
    grp  <- first_match(c(group, "group"), colnames(bundle$pcoa), group)
    xcol <- first_match(c("PC1", "Axis.1"), colnames(bundle$pcoa))
    ycol <- first_match(c("PC2", "Axis.2"), colnames(bundle$pcoa))
    if (!is.na(xcol) && !is.na(ycol)) {
      p <- plot_ly(bundle$pcoa, x = bundle$pcoa[[xcol]], y = bundle$pcoa[[ycol]],
                   color = if (!is.na(grp) && grp %in% colnames(bundle$pcoa))
                             bundle$pcoa[[grp]] else NULL,
                   text = bundle$pcoa$sample, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
                   marker = list(size = 10)) |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = xcol), yaxis = list(title = ycol))
      print(htmltools::tagList(p))
    } else {
      print(htmltools::tagList(rt(bundle$pcoa)))
    }
  } else cat("No PCoA scores.\n")

  cat("\n\n#### Alpha\n\n")
  if (!is.null(bundle$alpha)) print(htmltools::tagList(rt(bundle$alpha)))
  else cat("No alpha CSV.\n")

  cat("\n\n#### Categories (top-N)\n\n")
  if (!is.null(bundle$drug) && nrow(bundle$drug) > 0) {
    cn <- colnames(bundle$drug)
    cat_col <- first_match(
      c("DRUG", "VF_Category", "Function_group", "MGE_Category",
        "category", "class"),
      cn, cn[[1]])
    val_col <- first_match(
      c("Total_TPM", "total_TPM", "totalTPM", "totCount", "value"),
      cn, if (length(cn) >= 2) cn[[2]] else NA_character_)
    if (!is.na(cat_col) && !is.na(val_col)) {
      df <- bundle$drug
      df <- df[order(-df[[val_col]]), ]
      df <- head(df, rcfg$top_n_genes)
      p <- plot_ly(df, x = df[[cat_col]], y = df[[val_col]], type = "bar") |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = cat_col, tickangle = -45),
               yaxis = list(title = val_col))
      print(htmltools::tagList(p))
      print(htmltools::tagList(rt(bundle$drug)))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("Unrecognised columns in %s table: %s\n",
                  label, paste(cn, collapse = ", ")))
    }
  } else cat("No category-level TPM table.\n")

  cat("\n\n:::\n")
}

render_ge_panel("Resistome (AMR)", art$resistome)
render_ge_panel("Virulome (VF)",   art$virulome)
render_ge_panel("Mobilome (MGE)",  art$mobilome)
```
